violations.text: Raw animal foods (such as beef) were observed stored above ready-to-eat foods (such as whipped cream and veggies) in the prep unit. Raw animal foods must be separated from raw ready-to-eat food such as vegetables during storage. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 10/07/2026

Proper cooling methods were not used for time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods. Chicken and shrimp was placed hot in the refrigerator and covered. Cooling methods reviewed with staff at the time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 10/07/2026

Working containers of dry ingredients are not labeled with the common name of the food. Working containers holding food or food ingredients that are removed from their original packages, such as flour, herbs, salt, sugar, and spices must be labeled with the common name of the food. New Violation. Correct By: 10/07/2026

The presence of roaches is not controlled as evidenced by activity on glue traps. The presence of insects, rodents, and other pests must be controlled by routinely inspecting the premises for evidence of pests, using acceptable methods to control pests, eliminating harborage conditions, and routinely inspecting incoming shipments of food and supplies. Establishment must thoroughly clean and sanitize the warewashing, grease trap area, and cookline daily to prevent the attraction/harborage of insect activity. Establishment to have pest control complete full evaluation of facilities for pest activity. All areas/equipment in the kitchen must be cleaned and sanitized daily to prevent harborage conditions for pests. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 05/27/2026

Sticky fly traps were observed hanging in the food preparation areas. Insect control devices must be installed in a manner to prevent the possible contamination of food. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 10/07/2026

Dry foods and foods in the refrigeration were observed opened or uncovered. All foods must be kept covered/protected from the environment at all times besides during food preparation. New Violation. Correct By: 10/07/2026

The following was observed: 1) Knives were stored in-between the prep units 2) Containers were observed used as scoops 3) Utensils in stagnant water Equipment moved to proper areas. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 10/07/2026

The following must be cleaned and sanitized: 1) The hood vents were observed with an accumulation of grease 2) The ice machine was observed with black resiude 3) The exterior of all the refrigeration units were observed with food debris 4) The shelving and cooking equipment at the cookline were observed with an accumulation of food debris and grease 5) The hibachi stations were observed with excess grease in the grease traps New Violation. Correct By: 10/07/2026
The floors and walls in the kitchen and bar area were observed with an accumulation of debris, grease, and food residue. New Violation. Correct By: 10/07/2026
The grout in the kitchen warewashing area and the bar was observed in poor repair. Grout must be repaired to prevent excess water pooling. New Violation. Correct By: 10/21/2026

The presence of roaches is not controlled as evidenced by live activity in the warewashing area. 1 live insect was observed at the time of inspection. The presence of insects, rodents, and other pests must be controlled by routinely inspecting the premises for evidence of pests, using acceptable methods to control pests, eliminating harborage conditions, and routinely inspecting incoming shipments of food and supplies. Establishment to continue following plan of action along with any recommendations made by pest control. Establishment must thoroughly clean and sanitize the warewashing and grease trap area daily to prevent the attraction/harborage of insect activity. Establishment to continue following plan of action along with any recommendations made by pest control. All areas/equipment in the kitchen must be cleaned and sanitized daily to prevent harborage conditions for pests Repeat Violation. Correct By: 05/27/2026

The following non-food contact surfaces must be cleaned: 1) The dish machine was observed with an accumulation of debris/water 2) The shelving in the dish area was observed with food debris 3) The grease trap was observed with an accumulation of food debris/grease All surfaces must be cleaned and sanitized. Food debris, grease and/or other products that may attract pest activity must be removed from all surfaces. All equipment and utensils must be cleaned and dried before the end of day. New Violation. Correct By: 07/15/2026

The presence of roaches is not controlled as evidenced by dead roaches on glue traps and live activity near the grease trap and ware-washing area. The presence of insects, rodents, and other pests must be controlled by routinely inspecting the premises for evidence of pests, using acceptable methods to control pests, eliminating harborage conditions, and routinely inspecting incoming shipments of food and supplies. Establishment to continue following plan of action along with any recommendations made by pest control. All areas/equipment in the kitchen must be cleaned and sanitized daily to prevent harborage conditions for pests. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 05/27/2026

The following non-food contact surfaces must be cleaned: 1) The non-food contact surfaces of the prep table were observed wrapped in aluminum foil. 2) The wok-line was observed with water pooling 3) The 3-bay sinks were observed with dishes soaking in water All surfaces must be cleaned and sanitized. Food debris, grease and/or other products that may attract pest activity must be removed from all surfaces. All equipment and utensils must be cleaned and dried before the end of day. New Violation. Correct By: 06/10/2026

The presence of roaches is not controlled as evidenced by dead roaches on glue traps and live activity near the grease trap, bar, cookline, ware-washing area, and under the refrigeration units/shelving area. The presence of insects, rodents, and other pests must be controlled by routinely inspecting the premises for evidence of pests, using acceptable methods to control pests, eliminating harborage conditions, and routinely inspecting incoming shipments of food and supplies. - Establishment to continue following plan of action along with any recommendations made by pest control. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 05/27/2026

The following non-food contact surfaces must be cleaned: 1) The non-food contact surfaces of the prep tables and the wall next to the dishwasher was observed wrapped in aluminum foil. 2) The grease trap was observed with an accumulation of grease 3) The hibachi areas were observed with an accumulation of grease 4) The 3-bay sinks were observed with dishes soaking in water All surfaces must be cleaned and sanitized. Food debris, grease and/or other products that may attract pest activity must be removed from all surfaces. All equipment and utensils must be cleaned and dried before the end of day. New Violation. Correct By: 05/27/2026

The following was observed in poor repair: 1) The metal sheets behind the wok line was tightly secured to the wall 2) The 3-bay sink was observed not tightly secured to the wall 3) The grout around the 3-bay sink in the kitchen was observed to be lifting/missing. New Violation. Correct By: 05/27/2026

The presence of roaches is not controlled as evidenced by dead roaches on glue traps and live activity near the grease trap, bar, cookline, ware-washing area, and under the refrigeration units/shelving area. The presence of insects, rodents, and other pests must be controlled by routinely inspecting the premises for evidence of pests, using acceptable methods to control pests, eliminating harborage conditions, and routinely inspecting incoming shipments of food and supplies. - A full evaluation by pest control must be performed before the next inspection. The full evaluation must include frequency of treatment, types of bait, traps, activity levels from traps/any live or dead sightings, structural findings, and technician assessment. Establishment must fulfill all of the recommendations by pest control. Pest control to increase frequency until roach activity is resolved. Evaluation to be sent to inspector before next inspection. An increase in pest control visits recommended from 2x monthly to weekly or 2x weekly. - Establishment to create a plan of action to follow alongside the findings from the evaluation. Plan of action to include cleaning and sanitizing of all areas observed with activity. New Violation. Correct By: 05/14/2026
The metal sheet in the hibachi area was observed in poor repair (not tightly secured). The area must be repaired to prevent any harborage area of insects. New Violation. Correct By: 05/14/2026

The following non-food contact surfaces must be cleaned: 1) All of the prep tables were observed with food debris 2) The exterior/interior of the refrigeration units observed with grease build up and food debris 3) The cooking equipment (wok line, fryolator, grill) were observed with food debris/grease build up under and around it 4) The grease trap was observed with an accumulation of food debris and grease 5) The shelving holding utensils/equipment behind the cookline were observed with dust and food debris 6) Parts of the dishwasher were observed with build up 7) The hibachi areas were observed with an accumulation of grease All non-food contact surfaces must be cleaned and sanitized to prevent the attraction of insects. New Violation. Correct By: 05/14/2026

The following was observed of the physical facilites: 1) The floors under the cookline and under the cooking equipment were observed with an accumulation of grease and food debris 2) The walls behind the cookline were observed with an accumulation of grease 3) The walls at the bar areas were observed with dust 4) The floors under the hibachi stations were observed with food debris New Violation. Correct By: 05/14/2026

The non-food contact surfaces of the soda lines in the bar ice wells were observed with black residue. The unused water wall was observed with debris. The non-food contact surfaces must be cleaned as often as necessary. New Violation. Correct By: 03/30/2026
The floors under the cookline and under the 3-bay sink was observed with an accumulation of grease and food debris. New Violation. Correct By: 03/30/2026

Raw animal foods (such as beef and wontons) were observed stored above ready-to-eat foods (such as veggies) in the walk-in refrigerator. Raw animal foods must be separated from raw ready-to-eat food such as vegetables during storage. Foods were relocated to proper areas. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 02/05/2026

Salmon and tuna poke bowls are served raw or undercooked to the customer's request. A written consumer advisory (on the menu, table tent, or placard) is not provided to the consumer informing them of the significantly increased risk associated with certain vulnerable consumers eating such food in a raw or undercooked form. New Violation. Correct By: 02/05/2026

Insect sticky traps were observed hanging from the ceiling in the kitchen. Insect control devices shall be installed in a manner to prevent possible contamination of food/equipment/single service items. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 02/05/2026

The following was observed of non-food contact surfaces: 1) The exterior/interior of the prep units were observed with food debris 2) The exterior/interior of the sliding door coolers were observed with food debris 3) The prep table near the cookline was observed with foil/food debris New Violation. Correct By: 02/05/2026

The walls behind the cookline has an accumulation of soil residue and food debris. The physical facilities shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. New Violation. Correct By: 02/05/2026

Employees' clothing or other personal belongings were observed stored in the dry storage areas. Lockers or other suitable facilities shall be used for the orderly storage of employees' clothing and other possessions. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 02/05/2026

The thermometer is the sushi display cooler was observed to be in poor repair (inaccurate reading of temperature). Thermometers disposed of at the time of inspection. New thermometers to be placed in units to accurately read ambient temperature of refrigeration units. New Violation. Correct By: 07/21/2025
The establishment did not keep Time as a Public Health Control logs for 90 days for sushi rice. New Violation. Correct By: 06/25/2025

Proper cooling methods were not used for time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods. Various foods were observed cooling in containers and covered on the counter and prep unit cooler. Foods left uncovered/moved to walk-in cooler to cool properly. Proper cooling methods reviewed with person in charge. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 06/25/2025

Reduced oxygen packaged fish labeled "KEEP FROZEN" was observed thawing with the package in-tact. Fish was observed at 33 degrees Fahrenheit and removed from packaging. Reduced oxygen seafood must be removed from the bag to allow for proper oxygen transfer. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 06/25/2025

Working containers of dry ingredients are not labeled with the common name of the food. Working containers holding food or food ingredients that are removed from their original packages, such as flour, herbs, salt, sugar, and spices must be labeled with the common name of the food. New Violation. Correct By: 02/21/2025
The facility is lacking test strips to measure the concentration of the quaternary ammonium sanitizing solution for the 3-bay sinks at the bar. New Violation. Correct By: 02/21/2025
The faucet of the prep sink was observed to be leaking. Per PIC, a maintenance service has been requested. New Violation. Correct By: 02/21/2025

The floors under the cookline have an accumulation of soil residue and food debris. The physical facilities shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. New Violation. Correct By: 02/07/2025

Employees' clothing or other personal belongings were observed stored in the dry food storage area. Lockers or other suitable facilities shall be used for the orderly storage of employees' clothing and other possessions. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 02/07/2025
